verdict.rationale: Docs repeatedly state DeepInfra is pure pay-as-you-go per-token pricing with no contracts, no seat fees, and no sales interaction required ('Low pay-as-you-go pricing - no long-term contracts, no hidden fees'; 'You only pay per token'), implying self-serve transparent pricing. However, the pack contains no direct citation of an actual per-model price table or specific $/token figures for individual hosted models. Missing for 10: a concrete pricing-page excerpt listing per-model token rates, and independent confirmation that all models (not just LLMs) have published prices without sales contact.
